# Lane briefs v24.15

Read the [profile](EXTERNAL_PROFILE_v24.15.md), immutable event/contract requirements and your current packet at the supplied commit. Use its exact requirement IDs/field names and fixed return. Report partial/unavailable facts explicitly. Every lane works on the same official home/away assignment, native event and evidence horizon.

| Lane | Work | Output and handoff |
|---|---|---|
| L1 Availability | Both sides' confirmed starters/roles, bench, absences, suspensions and final changes. Goalie/pitcher/QB and cricket toss where applicable. Reopen timed official releases; projections stay projected. | Evidence and requirement dispositions; list actual claim identities and original source collectors for L4. |
| L2 History | Exact-competition results, season and L5/L10/L15/L20 true n. Reconcile new games after the dated history pack, duplicates, forfeits and endpoints. Cricket views explicitly name batting-first/chasing/bowling-first selection. | Evidence, calculation/source provenance and requirement dispositions. Missing competition/format is not a proxy authorization. |
| L3 Conditions/rules | Verified start/zone, venue/neutrality, match-window weather, officials if published, rest/travel/stage, and exact period/endpoint/action/unit of every supplied contract. | Evidence and requirement dispositions. Contradictory overtime/regulation or action definitions are explicit conflicts. |
| L4 Independent check | Wait for accepted L1. Reopen its exact decisive claims using genuinely separate collectors. Identify copied feeds, contradictions, disputed roles and missing original releases. | Evidence and requirement dispositions in L1's field names; do not settle disagreements by majority. An L1 correction invalidates this return. |
| L5 Central-evidence pricing | Wait for all assigned upstream roles and the reviewed merged evidence package. Use the frozen reference, scoped effect rows and declared mixtures; price each supported supplied contract once from one distribution. | Full kit receipts and exact PROBABILITIES plus UNPRICED coverage, plus requirement dispositions. No hand-edited p, no sensitivity result in the primary block. An upstream/source-review correction invalidates this return. |

L1-L4 return no probabilities. L5 covers the manifest's exact labels with numeric receipt-bound rows or reasoned UNPRICED rows. Different endpoint readings are separate explicit contracts; do not resolve them silently. The repository writer independently verifies every receipt, then makes one final card. Chat agreement never supplies additional sporting trials.

The five-chat process requires owner handoffs; the coordinator does not silently read other chat histories. Request the exact refreshed packet rather than relying on a summary or memory. Raw refusals and corrected originals stay retained. Once the card is bound, later changes are dated addenda, never replacement forecasts.


**L6 (FULL_SIX only):** independent extra audit, using assigned exact field/requirement identities, upstream of L5. Reduced mode uses only its assigned roles and records omissions/reason; it cannot claim the missing checks. Every supplied contract appears once across numeric PROBABILITIES and reasoned UNPRICED. Read the actual Python UTC clock; no invented timing.
